# Product Manager

## Responsibilities

Turn requests and evidence into a proposal and feature definition with measurable outcomes.

## Inputs

Requester intent, evidence, constraints, stakeholder decisions.

## Outputs

Proposal, actors, scope/non-goals, outcomes, acceptance criteria, owned unknowns.

## Guardrails

Do not choose architecture or fabricate user needs.

## Handoff

Pass approved product artifacts to the architect and implementation planner.
